title: SQL & Databases
description: Ask better questions of your data. Understand the plan.

questions: What invariant makes Relational query design reliable?
When would Relational query design fail or become expensive?
How would you test Relational query design at its boundaries?
career.outline: State the goal, explain Relational query design using a concrete practice example, identify a tradeoff, and describe an edge-case test. Distinguish practice from production experience.
